In a corner she sees an unknown girl standing. My mother's second brother that is my Uncle Nazeer puts off the fire! Then she is breastfeeding an infant and the infant refuses to drink. 3.She is breastfeeding an infant and only a drop goes inside the infant's mouth and it spits out and my mother's whole face gets covered with milk. 4.
